name: Automatic Toothpaste Dispenser Set with Wall-Mounted Toothbrush Holder | Touch-Free Bathroom Organizer
description:
Keep your bathroom organized and hygienic with this Automatic Toothpaste Dispenser Set. Designed for touch-free convenience, it dispenses just the right amount of toothpaste and includes a wall-mounted toothbrush holder for up to 5 brushes. Easy to install without drilling, compact, and perfect for modern bathrooms.
Key Features
 Hands-free automatic toothpaste dispenser
 Wall-mounted, no drilling installation
 Holds & organizes up to 5 toothbrushes
 Compatible with most toothpaste tubes
 Durable, refillable, and easy to clean
 Sleek, compact, and space-saving design
Ingredients / Materials
High-quality ABS plastic
How to Use
 Mount the dispenser on a clean wall surface without drilling
 Insert toothpaste tube into the dispenser
 Press toothbrush against the lever for mess-free dispensing
 Store brushes in the holder to keep them clean and dust-free
Package Includes
 1 × Automatic Toothpaste Dispenser
 1 × Wall-Mounted Toothbrush Holder (fits 5 brushes)
 1 × Adhesive Mounting Kit
